scripts.repo:guard: uv run --all-packages python -m unittest tests.test_docs_structure tests.test_workspace_layout tests.test_repo_collaboration tests.test_package_script_policy tests.ingestion.test_ingestion_task_executability tests.api.test_app_api_collector_execution_boundary -q && pnpm --filter repo-governance test
scripts.ci:contracts: pnpm contracts:check && uv run --all-packages python -m unittest discover -s tests/contracts -t . -q
scripts.ci:ingestion: uv run --all-packages python -m unittest discover -s tests/ingestion -t . -q
scripts.ci:langfuse: pnpm --dir packages/eval-langfuse typecheck && pnpm --dir packages/eval-langfuse test && pnpm --dir apps/app-api exec tsx ./scripts/check-langfuse-trace-id-vectors.ts
scripts.ci:config:lint: pnpm ci:actions:lint && uv run --all-packages python -m scripts.check_ci_workflow_contracts && uv run --all-packages python -m scripts.check_workflow_action_policy
scripts.contracts:check: uv run --all-packages python -m scripts.check_contract_schemas && uv run --all-packages python -m scripts.generate_tool_execution_contracts --check
scripts.go:check: test -z "$(gofmt -l apps/execution-control)" && cd apps/execution-control && go vet ./... && export PATH="$(go env GOPATH)/bin:$PATH" && if ! command -v golangci-lint >/dev/null 2>&1; then echo 'golangci-lint v2.11.4 is required. Install it from https://golangci-lint.run/welcome/install/'; exit 1; fi && golangci-lint run ./... && go test ./...
